body:

![Logo](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/539/iceology-logo-png.png)

Special thanks to the Wicks for composing some of the music found in this mod!

https://www.youtube.com/@WhiteWicks


Curseforge page is [Here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/iceology)


What if the Iceologer got its own update? That's what this mod is about! It adds a new dimension known as Frostholm, full of towering mountains and cavernous valleys. A powerful new crafting system also exists within this mod! The portal for this dimension can be found in a Mountain Cabin in the Overworld.

![Mountain Cabin](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/540/cabin-png.png)

Iceologers that spawn in Raids can drop a map leading to this place. You will also want to obtain an Iceology Wand from an Iceologer to be able to make many of the things in this mod.



DO NOT read beyond this point if you don't want spoilers! Take a look at the Advancements tab for a bit of guidance if you want to go in blind.



## New Additions:

# Blocks

Penimerite:

 -This cold version of Stone is the main underground block of Frostholm. It can be made into bricks to create a portal and can be made by using any type of Iceology Wand on normal Stone.

Penimerite Ores:

 -There are three Vanilla Ores found in Frostholm; Iron, Diamond, and Emerald. They spawn more often here than normal Overworld ores.

Ancient Ice:

 -An extra slippery variant of Ice found in the Deepsnow Peaks of Frostholm. It is used in making the basic Iceology Wand and the Iceology Table, two very important items.

Ancient Icicle:

 -A common block found on the floors and ceilings of caves in Frostholm. It has no use.

Permafrost:

 -An icy version of Dirt found in Frostholm.

Snowcapped Grass:

 -This variant of grass does not drop Wheat Seeds. It can be found in Frostholm and can be Snowlogged.

Cordalbloom:

 -A purple flower found in Frostholm. It can be Snowlogged.

Starnis:

 -A tall glowing plant found in any biome of Frostholm, with it being more common in Deepsnow Peaks.

Icemoss:

 -A variant of moss found in Frostholm Caves. This is pretty much the same as normal moss, except for the fact that the Sprouts glow.

Coldglow Wood:

 -A new dark purple wood set found in the Coldglow Woods biome. It has a few special crafting uses, such as making Iceology Tables and Frost Handles.

Heated Lamp:

 -A decorative light block crafted from Orkullun Ingots and a Torch on the Iceology Table.

Iceology Table:

 -A very important crafting station from this mod. It allows the player to create unique resources that can't be found anywhere else or modify gear. You need an Iceology Wand to use this block.

Creeping Iceweaver:

 -A frozen bush made with Sweet Berries and Blizzard Charges on the Iceology Table. It freezes mobs that walk in it.

Frostcaller Heart:

 -A functional block crafted with rare resources that can be used to make a Frostcaller. Place this block with a Block of Orkullun above and below it, then place a Carved Pumpkin on top of the pillar to spawn a Frostcaller.

Penimerite Core:

 -This block is used to create a portal to Frostholm. You can craft it on the Iceology Table.

Mysterious Ice:

 -Magically imbued ice found inside the portal frame of Mountain Cabins. Use a Warm Key on the Penimerite Core to break it.

Chthonic Safe:

 -A special container found in Frozen Chambers. It can be unlocked with a Warm Key, which will allow you to loot it. Special items not found anywhere else can be obtained from this block. They will reset 45 minutes after being opened.


# Ores

Orkullun:

![Orkullun Ore](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/561/1-png.png)

Orkullun is a metal found at most heights in Frostholm, with it being more common lower down. It can also be made by using an Iceology Wand on any Iron ore or block, making it renewable. It is used for many recipes in Iceology, it can be used as a trim material, and It can be made into decorative variants such as chains and Lanterns.

Chthonic Ice:

![Chthonic Ice](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/562/2-png.png)

Chthonic Ice is a semi-rare material found deeper in Frostholm. It is used for some higher end crafting recipes and as a modifier for weapons.

Mendrilite:

![Crafting Mendrilite](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/563/3-png.png)

This is an alloy metal made with Orkullun, Diamond, and Blizzard drops. It is used to make equipment, trim armor, and as decoration, coming in the same variants that Orkullun decorations do. Crafting Mendrilite with a basic Iceology Wand requires an Orkullun Ingot, Diamond, and Blizzard Rod, but if you make the Greater Iceology Wand, then you can make an ingot with a Block of Orkullun, Diamond, and Bottle of Freezing Heart.


# Items

Frost Handle:

 -This is an important item used in making Iceology Wands and Mendrilite tools. It can be crafted on the Iceology Table with two Coldglow Planks and an Orkullun Nugget.

Iceology Wand:

 -The most basic version of the Iceology Wands, this can be used to craft a limited number of items on the Iceology Table, such as more wand, Heated Lamps, and Mendrilite Nuggets. Its other uses include being able to convert some Overworld blocks to Iceology blocks or summon an Ice Chunk on an entity at a range.

Chthonic Ice Chunk:

 -Dropped from Chthonic Ice Ore, this item's primary use is to make Chthonic Ice for crafting, but you can apply to a weapon to grant it +0.5 Attack Damage and -0.1 Attack Speed.

Mendrilite Tools:

 -These tools, made from Mendrilite Ingots and Frost Handles, are pretty similar to Diamond, having slightly better stats and being able to repair themselves while the holder is in Frostholm.

Greater Iceology Wand:

 -An upgraded version of the Iceology Wand crafted from a Frost Handle, Mendrilite Ingot, and Chthonic Ice that can do more things, such as converting Blocks of Iron to blocks of Orkullun, modifying equipment, and making higher tier items in the Iceology Table.

Blizzard Rod:

 -A common drop from Blizzards that can be used to make Blizzard Charges, Blue Fabric, and Mendrilite Nuggets. Brewing this item with an Awkward Potion will make Potions of Freeze resistance.

Blizzard Charge:

 -A projectile item that acts like a Snowball. It will inflict the Frozen effect on an entity that is hit.

Bottle of Freezing Heart:

 -A valuable item that can be obtained by using a Glass Bottle on a Blizzard with less than one health point. It is used to make Mendrilite Ingots and Freezing Potions, along with being able to modify core armor, giving the +1 Max Health modifier. Consuming this item will give you a temporary extra Heart.

Blue Fabric:

 -A crafting ingredient made with Orkullun Nuggets, Blizzard Rods, and Blue Wool. Modifying a Chestplate with it will make the wearer immune to Powdered Snow damage.

Iceologer Robes:

 -This three-piece armor set will make you immune to Powdered Snow and the Frozen Effect. It is crafted using Orkullun and Blue Fabric.

Warm Key:

 -A key dropped from Iceologers or Trial Spawners used to unlock Chthonic Safes, Vaults, and Mountain Cabin Portals.

Frostbite Lighter:

 -The Frostholm Portal's igniter. It can be crafted on an Iceology Table with a Flint, Ancient Ice, and Orkullun.

Equipment Modifiers:

 -There are many items found in this mod that can be used to modify your existing Equipment, and many of them are found in Chthonic Safes, with the exceptions of a few craftable ones and Mendrilite Plating, which is dropped from hostile Frostcallers. Each has their own special abilities and they can stack.

Snowflake Banner Pattern:

 -A special banner pattern found in Iceologer Villages.

Smithing Templates:

 -This mod includes a new Armor Trim and Upgrade template:
 
  -The Chilly Armor Trim is found in Iceologer Villages
  
  -And the Chthonic Ice Upgrade is found in most structures

Music Disc:

 -A brand new Music Disc can be found in Iceologer Villages known as Verglas, composed by the Wicks!

Blade of Frostholm:

 -This is a craftable special weapon. It can Parry Attacks, and when you do parry it will make your next hit stronger.

Reshaping Glacier:

 -A craftable multitool that can mine most blocks that Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels, and Hoes can. It will change shape to match the block you are looking at.

New Painting:

 -A new Painting variant can be found in this mod called Abode. It depicts an Iceologer's house in Frostholm and is a 3x3 painting.

 
# New Enchantments

Frost:

 -A bow enchantment found in most places in Frostholm. It will freeze the target when they are hit with any arrow. Max level is I.

Glacial Speed:

 -This goes on Iceology Wand to reduce the cooldown between summoning Ice Chunks. Max level is III.

Ice Aspect:

 -A sword enchantment that freezes the target when struck, similar to Frost. Max level is II.

Icewoven:

 -A rare enchantment that allows Iceology Wands to repair themselves when held while the holder is in Frostholm. Max level is I.

Titan's Guard:

 -An enchantment for the Blade of Frostholm that further reduces the damage taken when blocking. Max level is III.

 
# Mobs

Iceologer:

![Iceologer](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/564/iceologer-png.png)

This illager calls Frostholm its home. They are found often in Iceologer Villages in Frostholm and Mountain Cabins in the Overworld, while also occasionally appearing in Raids.

Stats:

HP: 24

Atk: 20 (From Ice Chunk)

Def: 0

Drops:

 -1 Warm Key (20%)
 
 -1 Iceology Wand (Can be enchanted, 8.5%, increased with Looting)
 
 -1 Mountain Cabin Explorer Map (50%, only if in a Raid)

 

Blizzard:

![Blizzard](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/565/blizzard-png.png)

This is a frozen version of a Blaze that spawns in the Deepsnow Peaks of Frostholm. It has four Blizzard Charges floating around it, which it will shoot at a target. Once it runs out of Blizzard charges, it will try to attack the target with melee hits. If you use a Glass Bottle on this mob when it has less that one health remaining, then it will instantly kill the Blizzard and grant the player a bottle of Freezing Heart.

Stats:

HP: 20

Atk: 1 (Ranged), 6 (Melee)

Def: 0

Drops:

 -0-1 Blizzard Rod (+0-1 extra per level of Looting)

 

Frostcaller:

![Frostcaller](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/566/frostcaller-png.png)

The Frostcaller is a strong golem-like mob found in Frostholm or created by the player. It has two attacks: an occasional AOE slam attack and a melee attack. Hostile Frostcallers may drop the Medrilite Plating item modifier. You can heal player-created Frostcallers with Mendrilite Ingots.

Stats:

HP: 100

Atk: 19 (Slam), 11 (Melee)

Def: 0

Drops:

 -3-5 Orkullun Ingot
 
 -1 Bottle of Freezing Heart (33%)


 
# Biomes

Coldglow Woods:

![Coldglow Woods](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/568/cgw-png.png)

The Coldglow Woods is a common biome filled with Coldglow Trees, which can be used as normal wood or for crafting some special items.

Coldglow Woods Edge:

![Coldglow Woods Edge](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/569/cgwe-png.png)

A rare variant of the Coldglow Woods with small trees.

Everfrost Plain:

![Everfrost Plain](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/570/efp-png.png)

This is the most common biome in Frostholm. It contain more Snowcapped Grass thatn any other biome, and Coarse Permafrost is common here.

Deepsnow Peaks:

![Deepsnow Peaks](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/567/dsp-png.png)

This is an uncommon biome usually found in mountainous areas. Large floes of Ancient Ice spawn here, along with Blizzards.



# Structures

Mountain Cabin:

![Mountain Cabin](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/571/mc-png.png)

The Mountain Cabin is an uncommon Overworld structure found in Mountains. You can easily find this place by getting a map from an Iceologer in a Raid. The cabin usually consists of on main house with and Iceologer and a Vault in it, with a path leading to a ruined structure that houses a Frostholm portal and a Trial Spawner.

Frozen Chamber:

![Frozen Chamber](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/572/fc-png.png)

This is a common underground structure found in Frostholm. There is always one main room with a Chthonic safe that branches out into more rooms that can contain Trial Spawners, more Safes, or Orkullun Ore deposits.

Iceologer Village:

![Iceologer Village](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/573/iv-png.png)

An uncommon structure found on the surface of Frostholm. Many houses contain Iceology Tables, Chests, or Vaults, all of which can contain loot. A single Frostcaller spawns at the structure's center.
